title: InboxAI template: quickstart visuals, annotated screenshots and README diagrams
creator: Maya R. Chen
description: Produce a complete set of UX assets for the new InboxAI reference template used in Quickstarts: annotated product screenshots (desktop + mobile), a step-by-step README diagram set (architecture, token streaming flow, OAuth onboarding), hero GIF for the docs header, and export-ready Figma pages. Assets must be export-ready, follow the Console design tokens, and include accessibility annotations (contrast, keyboard states).
tasks: Audit existing InboxAI repo to identify screens and flows to capture (PR: #78)
Create 3 hero-ready annotated desktop screenshots (Compose, Conversation, Settings) with callouts and keyboard accessibility notes
Produce 2 mobile breakpoints of Conversation view (iPhone 12 and Pixel 5) with tap targets annotated
Design README diagram set: onboarding sequence (auth -> model selection -> first request), streaming token flow diagram (client -> proxy -> runtime -> client), and KV-cache illustration
Export hero GIF (5s) demonstrating streaming tokens and function calling mock response
Generate final export package: PNG @2x, SVG for diagrams, optimized GIF, and source Figma file with naming convention
Add alt text and copy suggestions for each screenshot in the deliverables doc
Hand off assets and write a short usage guide for Docs engineers and SDK examples
acceptance_criteria: All screenshots exported and uploaded to Drive in the path /InboxAI/quickstart-assets with naming convention: inboxai_<screen>_<desktop|mobile>_2x.png
README diagrams exported as SVG and embedded in the template README; sequence diagrams match the runtime flow in ENG-2910
Hero GIF passes size budget (<= 1.2MB) and demonstrates streaming token arrival in under 5s
Accessibility annotations present for each screen (contrast ratios, focus order, ARIA hints) and reviewed by accessibility rep
Design handoff includes a short change-log and a list of TODOs for follow-up A/B variants
Design review approved by PM (PM sign-off comment in ticket) and PR referenced in comments
